panels.description: NIC utilization vs per-core bandwidth baseline (Tencent CVM: 48MB/core, or 96MB if <=2 cores; packet budget 9w/15w).

targets.source:
# 1. 计算分子：(网络接收速率 + 网络发送速率) * 100
 (
    (
      max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_recv{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role="proxy"}[1m]))
      +
      max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_sent{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role="proxy"}[1m]))
    ) * 100
  )
  /
  # 2. 计算分母：(去重后的核心数 * 对应基准带宽)
  (
    # 逻辑 A：核心数 <= 2，用 96M 基准
    (
      count by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (group by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name,instance_role) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role="proxy"})) <= 2
    ) * (96 * 1024 * 1024)
    or
    # 逻辑 B：核心数 > 2，用 48M 基准
    (
      count by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (group by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name,instance_role) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role="proxy"})) > 2
    ) * (48 * 1024 * 1024)
  )

100 * (max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_recv{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="proxy"}[1m])) + max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_sent{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="proxy"}[1m]))) / sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="proxy"}[1m])) / 150000 and sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="proxy"}[1m])) <= 2 or (100 * (max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_recv{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="proxy"}[1m])) + max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_sent{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="proxy"}[1m]))) / sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="proxy"}[1m])) / 90000 and sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="proxy"}[1m])) > 2)

targets.source:
label_replace(
# 1. 计算分子：(网络接收速率 + 网络发送速率) * 100
 (
    (
      max by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role, shard) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_recv{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m]))
      +
      max by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role, shard) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_sent{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m]))
    ) * 100
  )
  /
  # 2. 计算分母：(去重后的核心数 * 对应基准带宽)
  (
    # 逻辑 A：核心数 <= 2，用 96M 基准
    (
      count by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role, shard) (group by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name,instance_role, shard) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role=~"m.*"})) <= 2
    ) * (96 * 1024 * 1024)
    or
    # 逻辑 B：核心数 > 2，用 48M 基准
    (
      count by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role, shard) (group by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name,instance_role, shard) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role=~"m.*"})) > 2
    ) * (48 * 1024 * 1024)
  ),
"shard", "$1", "shard", ".*-([^-]+)$"
)

label_replace(
100 * (max by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_recv{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m])) + max by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_sent{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m]))) / sum by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m])) / 150000 and sum by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m])) <= 2 or (100 * (max by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_recv{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m])) + max by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_sent{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m]))) / sum by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m])) / 90000 and sum by (ip, bk_target_cloud_id, shard) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard_name!~".*conf",rs_nm!~".*conf",set!~".*conf",shard!~".*conf",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role=~"m.*"}[1m])) > 2),
"shard", "$1", "shard", ".*-([^-]+)$"
)
